meta.name: find-skills
meta.description: Helps users discover and install agent skills when they ask questions like "how do I do X", "find a skill for X", "is there a skill that can...", or express interest in extending capabilities. This skill should be used when the user is looking for functionality that might exist as an installable skill.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 发现并安装可扩展功能的技能
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果用户常问如何实现某个功能，需要推荐安装技能。
copy.tagline_en: Discover and install skills to extend capabilities
copy.fit_line_en: For you if users often ask how to do something and need skill recommendations.

howto.what: 装上后,当你提出想完成某个任务或获取某种能力时,Claude 会在开放的技能生态中搜索、筛选并推荐合适的 agent 技能,同时给出安装命令;你同意后它还能代为安装。它会优先展示安装量高、来源可靠的技能。
howto.when: 当用户询问“怎么做某事”、“找某个技能”、“有没有能做某事的技能”,或表达想扩展助手能力时触发。

say.text: 帮我找一个生成 changelog 的技能
有没有做 PR review 的技能?
帮我装一下 react 性能优化那个技能

howto.what_en: Once installed, when you ask to accomplish a task or get a capability, Claude searches the open skill ecosystem, filters and recommends suitable agent skills, provides install commands, and can install them for you with your consent. It favors skills with high install counts and trustworthy sources.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you ask how to do something, ask to find a skill, ask if there's a skill for a capability, or express interest in extending the agent's abilities.

say_en.text: Find me a skill to generate changelogs
say_en.note: Claude runs npx skills find changelog and shows recommendations.

say_en.text: Is there a skill for PR reviews?
say_en.note: Claude searches for pr review skills and lists install commands.

say_en.text: Install the react performance skill for me
say_en.note: Claude runs npx skills add with -g -y to install.
